profile.name: Roane Purificacion
profile.headline: Data & Systems Specialist
profile.summary: Data and Systems Specialist with 6+ years working in data and systems — 2 professionally, 4+ through self-driven projects — within 5 years in media production. I manage 2–3 million files a year and maintain 100+ automated workflows, turning scattered manual processes into structured systems that run on their own. My production background, shooting and editing broadcast content end to end, is why I build around how work actually gets done.

bullets: Build new systems and refine existing ones to improve how the team works day to day.
Build, refine and maintain 100+ automated workflows across Zapier and other tools, eliminating an estimated at least 5-10 hours of manual work per week.
Troubleshoot technical system issues and resolve them.
Manage 2–3 million files annually, ensuring accurate file counts, proper upload, and correct storage across systems.
Archive expired files by removing them from the live server and migrating them to cold storage, keeping active storage lean and costs controlled.
Address client technical concerns directly via email.
Collect and organize client data into structured, ready-to-work projects for the team.
Photographed studio sessions and delivered edited finals to clients.
Handled post-production editing and file organization across sessions.
Managed point-of-sale transactions and daily customer service.
Produced educational video content for online classes, shooting and editing 30+ minute instructional sessions end to end.
Delivered finished content for distribution across local television, YouTube, and Facebook Live.
Directed studio shoots using green screen setups and managed on-location production as needed.
Handled full post-production independently — editing, keying, and final delivery for broadcast-ready output.
Maintained inventory records and stock accuracy, drove in-store sales, and produced handmade coconut headbands sold as part of the store's product line.
